title: cassinia laevis subsp. rosmarinifolia
intro: Cassinia laevis subsp. rosmarinifolia, commonly known as Rosmarinifolia, is a subspecies of shrub native to Australia. It is known for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues, including pain, fever, and inflammation. The health benefits of Cassinia laevis subsp. rosmarinifolia include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and fighting infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diterpenes, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
